title: Apple Corps denies Beatles reunion reports | 1971
content:
Apple Corps issued a press statement on 22 March 1971 denying that The Beatles were reforming.

It followed a report in the Daily Mirror newspaper claiming that a reunion with Klaus Voormann on bass guitar was being discussed.

I am instructed as press and public relations representative for John Lennon, George Harrison, Ringo Starr, Apple Corps Ltd., Mr. Allen Klein and ABKCO Industries Inc. to state that this story was completely incorrect. I am advised that (a) the Beatles are not re-forming and that consequently Klaus Voormann does not replace Paul McCartney; (b) Messrs. Lennon, Harrison and Starr did not meet last Friday night at the Apple HQ to discuss future recordings; (c) John Lennon, George Harrison and Ringo Starr did not send Paul McCartney a cable announcing that the group was recording, detailing times to attend the recording studio.
Les Perrin, Apple Corps
